# The OG Company

> The OG Company is an SEO and AEO/GEO (Answer Engine Optimization / Generative Engine Optimization) agency based in India. We get businesses recommended in AI search (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and Google AI Overviews) and turn that visibility into leads.

Canonical URL: https://theogcompany.com
Contact: hello@theogcompany.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/the-og-company

## What we do

One team runs a business's SEO and AEO end to end, fully managed. The client approves; we execute.

1. **AI Visibility Audit**: Map the questions buyers ask AI, show who AI recommends today, and deliver a gap report against competitors.
2. **Technical Fixes**: Schema and structured data, crawlability and sitemaps, robots.txt and llms.txt, so AI can read and trust the site.
3. **Content That Gets Cited**: Answer-first articles with FAQ schema, written for both AI engines and Google.
4. **Authority Building**: Presence on Reddit, Quora and industry sites, plus quality backlinks, on the sources AI already quotes.
5. **Refresh Engine**: Content refreshed every 45–60 days, with monitoring for AI model changes.
6. **Tracking & Reports**: Monthly reporting on share of AI answers, citations, traffic and leads attributed to AI sources.

## How it works

- Week 1 · Audit: find the questions buyers ask AI and who wins them today.
- Weeks 2–3 · Fix: build the technical foundation so AI can crawl and trust the site.
- Month 1+ · Publish: cited content plus authority on the sources AI already quotes.
- Every month · Grow: track, refresh and compound what works.

## Who it's for

Businesses whose customers research before they buy: SaaS, fintech, education, healthcare, legal and CA firms, real estate, D2C brands and professional services.

## Proof

The team co-founded OGcollege (https://ogcollege.io), an AI college counselling platform for Indian students, and engineered it to become the source AI cites for admission questions instead of buying ads:

- 800K+ Google AI Overview citations
- 3.5M+ organic impressions
- 17% share of authority on target topics

## Terms

- Month-to-month, no lock-in.
- Clients own all content and data.
- Nothing goes live without client approval.
- Honest reporting from a frozen prompt set tracked across AI engines; no fake ranking guarantees.

## How to engage

Book a free 30-minute call at https://theogcompany.com. On the call we show, live, what AI says about the business and its competitors, and send a free AI visibility snapshot afterwards.
